definition: the unknown force that decides how things end
description: In a floodlit stadium in the rain, a referee in a yellow shirt with a whistle in her mouth and a player in a dark navy kit kneel face to face in the mud, staring at a coin on the wet ground between them. The coin spins and comes to rest standing on its edge in the mud. The player gasps with her mouth wide open and puts her hand down on the ground, and the referee stares in surprise. Behind them a line of players in maroon kits waits in front of the packed stand.
